title: The pytest cache in build/ instead of the root
author: Claude-JG
description: pytest wrote .pytest_cache into the repository root on every run. cache_dir in [tool.pytest.ini_options] puts it into build/.pytest_cache; exudev clean removes it there, and still a .pytest_cache in the root left by older runs.
releaseNotes: The pytest cache is written into build/.pytest_cache instead of the repository root (cache_dir in pyproject.toml); exudev clean removes it.
